description:
Configure the 'ne:ne_countries' layer in GeoServer for production delivery. 

1. Enable HTTP Response Cache Headers with a cache time of 24 hours (86400 seconds).
2. Configure the WMS Attribution settings for the layer:
   - Title: 'Provided by Natural Earth'
   - Logo URL: 'http://localhost:8080/geoserver/ne_logo.png'
   - Logo Type: 'image/png'
   - Logo Width: 88
   - Logo Height: 31

GeoServer is running at http://localhost:8080/geoserver (admin / Admin123!). Navigate to the Layer configuration to make these changes.
